tour.title: Your progress
tour.body: Mark cases learned as you go, and this bar keeps count.

tour.title: Find a case
tour.body: Show learned or unlearned cases, search by name, or pick a category.

tour.title: One case, one card
tour.body: The picture shows the case, with the main algorithm under it. Animate plays it on a 3D cube.

tour.title: Drill the whole set
tour.body: Drill Set times you on every case in this set, weakest first.

tour.title: Open a case
tour.body: Click any card to see all its algorithms and pick your main one.

greetings.line: One case at a time. Mark it learned when you can do it without looking.

mastered: Learned! Drill it a few times today so it sticks.

tips: Use the category chips to learn similar cases together.
Can't decide between two algorithms? Drill both and keep the faster one.
Drill Set only queues the cases you've marked learned, unless you switch to All.
